title: ClarificationStructuredV1
description: Schema for structured clarification data attached to ToolMessage.additional_kwargs._clarification

_schema.description: Schema version identifier for frontend parsing, e.g. 'deerflow/clarification/v1'

type.description: Discriminant field identifying this as a clarification payload

id.description: The tool_call_id from the original ask_clarification tool call

context.description: Optional background context provided by the model

options.description: Suggested response options (may be empty for free-text input)

widget_hint.description: [DEPRECATED — use widget_hints instead] Legacy hint for the frontend on which interactive widget to render

widget_hints.description: Structured widget hints dict matching the WidgetHints interface in types.ts

multi_line.description: Whether text input should be multi-line

allow_custom.description: Whether custom text input is allowed (shows 'other' option)

confirm_phrase.description: Required confirmation phrase for high/critical risk confirmations

policy.description: [DEPRECATED — not emitted by code] Rate-limiting and timeout policy (defined in extension_manifest.json instead)
